title: User guide
intro: A short guide to using the Strobe collaborative labs.

teacher.title: For teachers
teacher.description: Sign in with a teacher account to manage the class and activities.
steps: Open a lab from the Labs menu and choose the teacher view.
Select an activity and adjust its available options in the corresponding panels.
Share the QR code or connection link with your students.

student.title: For students
student.description: Students join from their own devices and work together in the shared activity.
steps: Open the link or scan the QR code provided by the teacher.
Enter a display name when prompted, then wait for the session to start.
Inputs become available after the teacher starts the session.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: A session controls when students can work and records activity as it happens.
steps: The teacher selects Start session before work begins.
Changes and events are recorded automatically during the session.
Selecting End session locks student inputs again.

settings.title: Settings and scores
settings.description: Available options depend on the lab.
steps: The teacher can enable Feedback, Score, and Chat in Settings.
When Score is enabled, relevant scores are shown to students and in the student table where supported.
The student table indicates which participants are connected.

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: Chat is shared by teachers and students when enabled by the teacher.
steps: Type your message in the input at the bottom of the chat and send it.
Messages show the sender's name and time and are visible to all participants.
